tagline: Har router wahi same map banata hai, phir shortest path dhoondta hai.
description: OSPF woh routing protocol hai jo bahut si companies aur ISPs apne andar ke network mein chalate hain. Har router apne links ko ek chhote record LSA mein likhta hai, use baaki sabhi routers tak flood karta hai, aur phir shared map par Dijkstra ka shortest-path algorithm chala kar apni routing table banata hai.

normal.name: R1 network join karta hai
normal.summary: R1 boot hota hai, Hello se apne neighbours dhoondta hai, DR ke saath apna map sync karta hai aur routes compute karta hai.

steps.title: Hello, koi hai?
steps.desc: R1 224.0.0.5 par Hello multicast karta hai
steps.detail: R1 abhi boot hua hai. Har 10 seconds mein woh 224.0.0.5 par Hello bhejta hai, jo woh address hai jispar saare OSPF routers sunte hain. IP TTL 1 hai, isliye yeh is segment se bahar nahi jaata. R1 ne abhi tak kisi ko nahi suna, isliye uski neighbour list khaali hai aur use kisi DR ka pata nahi.

quiz.q: R2 ke Hello mein hello interval 10 s hai, lekin R1 ko 30 s configure kiya gaya tha. Kya hoga?
options: Dono 10 s par agree kar lenge
Dono 30 s par agree kar lenge
Dono ek doosre ke Hellos ignore karenge
quiz.why: Hello aur dead intervals, area, mask aur kuch options bilkul match hone chahiye. Nahi hue to Hello chupchaap ignore ho jaata hai aur koi neighbour nahi banta.

steps.title: Two-way contact
steps.desc: Har ek apne Hello mein doosron ko list karta hai
steps.detail: R3 aur R2 R1 ko sunte hain aur apne agle Hellos mein 1.1.1.1 ko neighbour list mein daal dete hain. Jab R1 kisi aur ke Hello mein apna router ID dekhta hai, to use pata chal jaata hai ki link dono taraf kaam karta hai. Ab neighbour 2-Way state mein hai.

steps.title: DR kaun hai?
steps.desc: Ek router poore segment ki taraf se bolta hai
steps.detail: Shared segment par har router ka har doosre router ke saath sync karna bekaar ki mehnat hogi. Isliye ve ek Designated Router (DR) aur ek backup (BDR) chunte hain. Sabse high priority jeetti hai, phir sabse high router ID. R3 (3.3.3.3) R1 ke aane se pehle hi jeet chuka tha, aur R2 backup hai. Naya aane wala kabhi chalte hue DR ko replace nahi karta, isliye R1 bas use accept kar leta hai.
facts: DROTHER: sirf DR aur BDR ke saath sync karta hai

quiz.q: Agar R1 ki priority 200 hoti (sabse high), to join karte waqt kya hota?
options: Jab tak current DR fail na ho, kuch nahi
quiz.why: OSPF elections pre-emptive nahi hote. Higher-priority router tabhi DR banta hai jab current DR aur BDR fail ho jaayein, jisse network stable rehta hai.

steps.title: Databases compare karo
steps.desc: Database Description packets batate hain ki kiske paas kya hai
steps.detail: R1 ab DR ke saath full adjacency banata hai. Pehle ve decide karte hain ki lead kaun karega: higher router ID wala (R3) master ban jaata hai aur DD sequence number chunta hai. Phir har ek Database Description packets bhejta hai jisme sirf un LSAs ke 20-byte headers hote hain jo uske paas hain, taaki dono dekh sakein ki kaun se missing hain ya out of date hain.

steps.title: Request, update, acknowledge
steps.detail: R1 un chaar LSAs ke liye Link State Request bhejta hai jo uske paas nahi hain. R3 Link State Update se reply karta hai jisme poore LSAs hote hain. R1 unhe 224.0.0.6 par acknowledge karta hai, jo woh address hai jispar sirf DR aur BDR sunte hain. Har LSA mein Fletcher checksum hota hai, isliye kharab LSA pakda jaata hai aur dobara maanga jaata hai.

quiz.q: R3 ke paas ab R1 ka naya Router-LSA hai. R3 use kisko bhejega?
options: Kisi ko nahi, R1 ke paas pehle se hai
quiz.why: DR naye ya badle hue LSAs ko poore segment mein 224.0.0.5 par flood karta hai, aur har router unhe aage pass karta hai, isliye area ke saare routers ke paas identical map ban jaata hai.

steps.title: SPF chalao
steps.detail: Poora map milne ke baad R1 khud ko root maan kar Dijkstra ka algorithm chalata hai. 203.0.113.0/24 tak pahunchne ke liye woh R3 se ja sakta hai (10 + 10 + 1 = 21) ya R2 se (10 + 50 + 1 = 61). R3 wala sasta path routing table mein jaata hai, aur desk ka ping usi ko follow karta hai.

quiz.q: Best path chunne ke liye OSPF kya add karta hai?
quiz.why: Har link ki ek cost hoti hai, aksar uski speed par based. OSPF sabse kam total cost wala path chunta hai, sabse kam hops wala nahi.

outro.title: Har jagah same map
outro.text: R1 ne Hellos se neighbours dhoondhe, maujooda DR ko accept kiya, databases compare kiye, missing LSAs khinche aur Dijkstra chalaya. Ab area ke har router ke paas identical map hai aur woh usi se apne shortest paths compute karta hai.
facts: DR aur BDR ke saath Full

link-down.name: Ek link fail ho jaata hai
link-down.summary: R3–R4 ka fibre kat gaya. Naye LSAs flood hote hain, har router SPF dobara chalata hai aur traffic R2 par chala jaata hai.

steps.title: Fibre kat gaya
steps.desc: R3 aur R4 ka link toot gaya
steps.detail: Kisi ne R3–R4 ka cable nikal diya. Dono routers ko interface turant down dikhta hai, isliye unhe 40 seconds dead timer ka wait nahi karna padta. Har ek us link ke bina naya Router-LSA banata hai aur use higher sequence number deta hai.

steps.title: Khabar flood karo
steps.detail: R3 DR hai, isliye woh apna naya LSA seedha 224.0.0.5 par flood karta hai. R4 apna LSA R2 ko bhejta hai, aur R2 use 224.0.0.6 par DR aur BDR ko pass karta hai; phir R3 use sabko re-flood karta hai. Routers LSA tabhi accept karte hain jab uska sequence number unke paas wali copy se higher ho, aur use sender ko chhod kar sabko aage pass karte hain.

quiz.q: R2 ko R4 ka naya LSA R4 se milta hai aur thodi der baad wahi LSA R3 se re-flood hoke milta hai. Doosri copy ka R2 kya karega?
options: Ignore karega: same sequence number, pehle se hai
quiz.why: Sequence number R2 ko batata hai ki uske paas yeh exact version pehle se hai, isliye duplicate bas acknowledge hoke drop ho jaata hai. Isi se flooding hamesha ke liye loop nahi karti.

steps.title: Acknowledge
steps.desc: Har LSA ka confirm hona zaroori hai
steps.detail: Flooding reliable hoti hai: har LSA acknowledge hota hai, aur jab tak ack na mile router use har 5 seconds mein dobara bhejta hai. R1 DR aur BDR ko 224.0.0.6 par acknowledge karta hai, aur R2 R4 ko acknowledge karta hai.

steps.title: Reconverge
steps.desc: SPF dobara chalta hai, traffic R2 par jaata hai
steps.detail: Baaki changes collect karne ke liye thodi der ruk kar har router SPF dobara chalata hai. R1 ke liye servers tak ka sirf ek path bacha hai, R2 se, cost 10 + 50 + 1 = 61. Routing table update hoti hai aur agla ping R2 se jaata hai. Poora change ek second se bhi kam mein ho gaya.

quiz.q: Fibre repair hone par R1 kya karega?
options: Hamesha R2 hi use karta rahega
Naye LSAs aur SPF ke baad R3 par wapas switch karega
quiz.why: Repair hue link se naye LSAs bante hain, sab SPF dobara chalate hain, aur sasta path (R3 se cost 21) apne aap phir jeet jaata hai.

outro.title: Khud theek ho gaya
outro.text: Ek link down hua, uske paas ke do routers ne naye LSAs flood kiye, aur har router ne same updated map se dobara calculate kiya. Kisi ko static route nahi badalna pada; traffic bas backup link par chala gaya.

cheatsheet.title: Neighbour states
items: Unke Hello mein apna naam dekha

cheatsheet.title: Yaad rakhne wale numbers
items: Hello 10 s, dead 40 s, LSA refresh 30 min
